invariant: A composite containing an entry or exit border point is non-autarkic and remains a live cluster in the root Graphviz graph. For the basic port branch selected when each border label's integer width is at most 40px, input points occupy the cluster's source rank, outputs occupy its sink rank, both use 12-by-12 RECTANGLE_PORT nodes, entry-point links bypass ordinary rank-same handling, and the visible cluster frontier is derived from normal interior boxes plus the border-point centers. Java paints all cluster chrome first, then paints leaves in GraphvizImageBuilder's depth-first group traversal: every leaf of one root composite precedes every leaf of the next composite, and unpackaged root leaves follow the grouped leaves.
causal_divergence: Java Entity.isAutarkic explicitly rejects groups containing non-normal leaves, so CucaDiagramSimplifierState leaves an entry/exit composite in the root GraphvizImageBuilder. ClusterDotString then constructs source and sink ranks for EntityImageStateBorder nodes, and Cluster.manageEntryExitPoint applies FrontierCalculator to move the visible boundary through those points. GraphvizImageBuilder.printGroups and printGroup create each group's leaves together in Bibliotekon's LinkedHashMap; SvekResult.drawU later paints that insertion order after all clusters. Rust originally fell through to the flat renderer for a one-composite entry/exit diagram. The first port retained live-cluster geometry but painted one global scope-position order, interleaving leaves from multiple root composites instead of preserving Java's per-group creation traversal.
planned_change: Retain one or more entry/exit composites in the root LayoutGraph. Register basic-branch border leaves with PlantUML's 12-by-12 port-node geometry, reproduce ClusterDotString's source/sink rank and entry-point edge-constraint rules, and port FrontierCalculator's boundary derivation. Emit all cluster chrome first, then stable-partition leaves by root-composite traversal before unpackaged root leaves, preserving each group's existing leaf order. The wider-label plaintext HTML-port branch is a separate mechanism because the vendored Graphviz build has no Expat table parser.
perturbation_axes: declaration order plus varied labels that remain in the basic port branch
